mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sys_user ( username, password, name, birthday, address, mobile_phone, email, gender, description, province, city, country, origin, crt_id, crt_name, crt_time, upd_id, upd_time, upd_name ) VALUES ( #{username}, #{password}, #{name}, #{birthday}, #{address}, #{mobilePhone}, #{email}, #{gender}, #{description}, #{province}, #{city}, #{country}, #{origin}, #{crtId}, #{crtName}, #{crtTime}, #{updId}, #{updTime}, #{updName} )
mapper.select: select count(1) from sys_user where mobile_phone = #{mobile}
select id, username, password, `name`, birthday, address, mobile_phone, email, gender, description from sys_user where username = #{username}

select su.id, su.username, su.password, su.`name`, su.birthday, su.mobile_phone as mobilePhone, su.gender, su.description, se.id as employeeId, se.identity, se.work_status as workStatus from sys_user su left join sys_employee se on su.id = se.user_id where su.username = #{username}

select su.id, se.id as employeeId, su.username, se.`name`, su.birthday, su.address, su.mobile_phone as mobilePhone, su.email, su.gender, su.description, su.province, su.city, su.country, su.origin, se.identity, se.work_status as workStatus, se.work_type as workType, se.contract_signing_date as contractSigningDate, se.entry_date as entryDate, se.graduated_school as graduatedSchool, se.education, se.leave_time as leaveTime, se.title, se.post_level as postLevel, se.emergency_contact as emergencyContact, se.emergency_contact_phone as emergencyContactPhone, se.discount, se.photo as photo, se.diploma_photo as diplomaPhoto, se.work_number as workNumber from sys_user su left join sys_employee se on su.id = se.user_id where su.id = #{userId}

SELECT user_info.*, ( SELECT GROUP_CONCAT( p.`name` ) FROM post p WHERE FIND_IN_SET( p.id, user_info.post_ids )) AS posts, ( SELECT GROUP_CONCAT( c.`name` ) FROM company c WHERE FIND_IN_SET( c.id, user_info.company_ids )) AS companys FROM ( SELECT su.id AS userId, se.id AS employeeId, su.username AS username, se.`name` AS name, sup.company_ids, sup.post_ids, se.birthday, se.address, su.mobile_phone AS mobilePhone, su.email, su.gender, su.description, se.province, se.city, se.country, se.origin, se.identity, se.work_status AS workStatus, se.work_type AS workType, se.contract_signing_date AS contractSigningDate, se.entry_date AS entryDate, se.graduated_school AS graduatedSchool, se.education AS education, se.leave_time AS leaveTime, se.title, se.post_level AS postLevel, se.emergency_contact AS emergencyContact, se.emergency_contact_phone AS emergencyContactPhone, se.discount, se.photo, se.diploma_photo AS diplomaPhoto, se.work_number AS workNumber FROM sys_user su LEFT JOIN sys_employee se ON su.id = se.user_id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT sup.user_id, GROUP_CONCAT( DISTINCT sup.company_id SEPARATOR ',' ) AS company_ids, GROUP_CONCAT( DISTINCT sup.post_id SEPARATOR ',' ) AS post_ids, GROUP_CONCAT( DISTINCT sup.group_id SEPARATOR ',' ) AS group_ids FROM sys_user_post sup GROUP BY sup.user_id ) sup ON su.id = sup.user_id ) user_info
and user_info.userId = #{queryFrom.userId}
and FIND_IN_SET(#{item}, user_info.company_ids)
and FIND_IN_SET(#{item}, user_info.group_ids)
and FIND_IN_SET(#{item}, user_info.post_ids)
and user_info.name like concact('%', #{queryFrom.keyWord} ,'%') or user_info.mobilePhone like concact('%', #{queryFrom.keyWord} ,'%')
and user_info.workStatus != #{queryFrom.workStatus}
